name: Dyclos
source:
Widely considered one of the greatest legends in the world, Dyclos is the pinnacle of success. Rich, well loved, and the ‘Hero of Kortia,’ he is extremely powerful, wielding not only magic, but blessings to rival no other.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
